name: gl_census
description: Phase-2b step 1 (doc/gl/instrumentation.md, 'The copy census' and 'Compares 13-15'): one owner session per place. The owner logs in, stands where the scene is worth measuring (Rooftops in a crowd; then home, or a dense-mesh place) and leaves the viewer alone. The tier is the feature table's Ultra list, as in mc1b. First the proofs: one flipped bit must be caught in the G-buffer (1), a probe face (13), the HUD (14, needs a worn HUD) and an impostor (15, needs an impostor regenerated within 120 frames); a pass that did not run is recorded as not proven and tried again after each run. The gate (G4-0b): 13, 14 and 15 proven and IDENTICAL in at least one run, or the run fails with what is missing. Then still (the view as it is): sun shadows, all shadows, few non-impostors (most avatars as impostors) and mirrors on; moving (turning at 10 deg/s): sun and all. Every run: the frame rate with nothing collecting, a timed window of 120 frames (counters per view and pass with the run-tracker extensions, CPU and GPU ms, window_<run>.json), the identical-image check on every pass, armed for up to 120 frames so the probe face, the HUD and an impostor can run (compare_<run>.json), the census records switched on (every draw item rebuilt with its record, 30 frames to settle), a census window of 120 frames (the copy census and the draw-state keys, census_window_<run>.json) and the resident copy census of the scene (census_resident_<run>.json), then the records off again.
